description: Fetches Delta Air Lines baggage policy information including carry-on rules, checked baggage fees, and FAQs from www.delta.com.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_carry_on_info: 获取随身行李规定、尺寸限制、允许携带物品清单; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_baggage_faqs: 获取行李常见问题解答列表; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - get_baggage_overview: 获取行李总览和费用信息; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - search_baggage_info: 搜索特定行李信息，需要query参数; 参数: query; 必填: 无

query.description:
搜索查询关键词，用于search_baggage_info功能。
示例: "carry-on size", "liquid restrictions", "military baggage"
